attchmntText: This is to inform you that the Company will hold a conference call on Saturday, 31st October 2026, at 11:00 AM (IST). During the call, the Management will comment on the financial results and operations for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026.

We enclose herewith the Newspaper Advertisement of the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and Half year ended 30th September 2026, published in Business Standard and Mumbai Lakshadeep.
We enclose herewith the Newspaper Advertisement regarding Notice of 1st EOGM scheduled to be held on Wednesday, 18th November 2026 at 11:00 AM in Business Standards and Mumbai Lakshadeep.
SKY GOLD AND DIAMONDS LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
Please see attached Copy of Press Release titled "Sky Gold and Diamonds Limited announces Q2 and H1 FY27 Financial Results; Revenue at Rs. 4,403.45 Crore, PAT up 111.9%."

Please find enclosed the notice of 1st Extra-Ordinary General Meeting for FY 2026-27 scheduled to be held on Wednesday, 18th November, 2026 at 11:00 AM (IST) through video conferencing (VC) / Other Audio- Visual Means (OAVM)

We wish to inform you that the Nomination and Remuneration Committee as its meeting held today i.e., on Tuesday, 27th October, 2026 has considered and approved the grant of 3,480 stock option to the eglibile employee of the Company under the SKY GOLD - ESOP 2024.

The Audit Committee and the Board of Directors have approved Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026 and the Limited Review Report thereon.

We wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company ( Board ) in its meeting held today, i.e. Tuesday, 27th October 2026 has inter alia considered and approved the following:01. Raising of funds not exceeding Rs. 1,800 crores by way of issuance of equity shares ( QIP )02. Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026 and the Limited Review Report thereon issued by the Statutory Auditor.03. Approved convening of the EOGM of the Company on Wednesday, 18th November 2026 at 11.00 A.M. 04. Considered and Approved the Notice of EOGM of the Company to be held on Wednesday, 18th November 2026.05. Appointed Mr. Shivang Goyal, Practicing Company Scrutinizer for conducting the e-voting process.

Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we would like to inform you that the Board of directors at its meeting held today i.e., on Friday, 16th October, 2026 has considered and approved the cessation of Ms. Aasna Shah as Internal Auditor w.e.f. 16th October 2026 and appointted M/s Doshi Jain & Co., Chartered Accountant as the Internal Auditor of the Company w.e.f. 16th October, 2026.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 and other applicable regulations of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors ( Board ) of the Company has, at its meeting held today, i.e., Friday,  16th October 2026, inter alia considered and approved: a) Cessation of Ms. Aasna Shah as Internal Auditor of the Company effective from  16th October, 2026. b) Appointment of M/s Doshi Jain & Co., Chartered Accountants as the Internal Auditor of the Company with effect from 16th October, 2026.

Please find enclosed herewith, the certificate under Regulation 74(5) of SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018 received from MUFG Intime India Private Limited for the quarter ended 30th September 2026.

attchmntText: We wish to inform you that the company has completed 100% acquisition of M/s. Purvi Gems & Jewellery (India) Private Limited on 7th October 2026.
We hereby enclose herewith the Press Release titled  Sky Gold & Diamonds to Acquire Purvi Gems in Strategic Move to Drive Growth, Achieve Scale and Product Diversification
